restoration_note: This kephalaion is structured as a litany of seven 'beforehand-before' clauses showing that the Father of Life had pre-shaped containment for every eruption of falsity. The repeated formula ⲍⲁⲧⲉⲍⲏ ⲉⲙⲡⲁⲧⲟⲩ- gives strong constraints on the closing 'before they begot' clause and on the Watchers/Giants section. Most editor restorations of formulaic elements (ⲁⲃⲁⲗ, ⲉⲙⲡⲁⲧⲉ, ⲥⲙⲓⲛⲉ, Gehennas, archonic host, clouds-winds, sea, beforehand) are confirmed. The chapter title (line 0) and several long lacunae (especially {17}, {26}, {35}) are too damaged for principled restoration. {19} could plausibly be ⲡⲁⲗⲁⲙⲁⲥ (the divine subduer) given character count and the fact that the next line explicitly continues 'he stood fast upon her until the end of the world' — the Adamas/Palamas of Light planted on Hyle.
